cues: Metaphor: an attempt at life, and made of nows.
The old guard and their desperate wings as a symbol of frightened tradition.
Paradox: each whiplash makes her see more clearly.
Repetition: forward, forward, the beat of footsteps.
And the long closing ellipsis: the homage still waiting, the future unwritten.
